items.title: Cathie Wood Dumps the Last of Teradyne From Her Flagship Fund

items.title: Wall Street’s Newest Teradyne Bull Just Sent a $2 Billion Signal That the Stock’s 56% Crash Went Too Far
items.summary: Teradyne jumped 8.3% to $265.78 on Wednesday after Jefferies started coverage at buy with a $284 target, calling it a compute test company with a possible $2 billion Nvidia revenue stream by 2029. The stock had lost 56% from its June 30 record to its November 5 close.
